dominant_strengths: Confident large display type with tight tracking establishes a clear, authoritative hero voice on dark canvas
High-fidelity product UI screenshot demonstrates craft, with believable issue tracker chrome, labels, and agent overlay
Restrained monochrome palette with subtle accent dots keeps focus on copy and product proof
dominant_weaknesses: Hero composition is heavily left-weighted; the right side feels barren until the eye drops to the product mock
Secondary 'Issue tracking is dead' callout competes awkwardly with nav and feels disconnected from the headline grid
Innovation is low—format mirrors every other dev-tool landing page, with little distinctive visual signature beyond the logo
fix_priorities: Rebalance hero by anchoring a supporting visual or eyebrow element on the right to counter the headline mass
Tie the 'linear.app/next' pill into a clearer visual hierarchy so it reads as a campaign link, not nav debris
Inject a more distinctive motif (texture, agent visualization) to differentiate from generic dark dev-tool aesthetic
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and solid visceral polish, but reflective layer is thin—nothing memorable beyond competent execution.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it reads unmistakably as Linear and clearly positions the product for teams-and-agents, with on-brand restraint.
